does: Decides whether a pair of entities deserves a combat log entry: no when the target is invisible and not a player; yes when either is a player or near a player, or either takes part in a fight with a player; otherwise no.

evidence.says: HasComponent Invisibility and Player on the target, then a player-or-near-player test and a fight-with-player test on each of the two
called once from ProcessHitEvents for each hit of the scenes (hit, miss, save, status tick)
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
